title: The Storm Approaches
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji revealed his true identity in the imperial city, the attention of the three major sects and the Demonic Path converged simultaneously—and the Heavenly Eye smiled from the shadows.

text.content: The instant the blood-stained page touched his palm, Chen Ji felt an icy, bone-piercing chill surge from his palm into his meridians, as if he had grasped a piece of万年玄冰. The characters on the page twisted like living creatures, writhing and climbing between his fingers, seemingly trying to burrow into his flesh and blood. The blood-stained surface emitted a诡异dark crimson glow, within which countless scenes flickered like a carousel—those were the final moments of countless prophets before their deaths.

Chen Tianming's hand withdrew into the rift, which was healing at a visible rate. His hoarse voice came through the narrowing gap: "The fourth page... records... your own death... remember... Chapter 700... is not the end... but the beginning..." Before the words finished, the rift closed completely, as if it never existed. Chen Ji gripped the page in his hand, his knuckles white, his expression deep and凝如渊.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's broken silhouette emerged from the first page, his voice drifting like a dying candle in the wind: "The fourth page... it should not awaken at this time. The prophecy you saw—your death at Chapter 700—is your destined calamity. Unless..." He paused, "Unless you can find that variable."

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, arranging the fourth page fragment alongside the three pages he already possessed. When the four pages of the Tianji Record appeared together, the paper suddenly burst with blinding golden light. In an instant, countless pieces of information flooded into his Mental Sea like a torrent—the list of Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's hidden agents in the imperial court, the power distribution map within Xuanwu Sect, the binding structure by which Holy Sect controlled Chen Nian...... Three originally scattered clues perfectly intertwined at this moment, forming a complete chess game.

He saw Chen Nian—the girl chained and imprisoned on the Holy Sect's altar, her eyes hollow, only flickering with faint light when looking in a certain direction. She was waiting for him. That little girl who had been calling his name when she was taken away had now become the key lock that could pry open Heavenly Fate. Her existence could interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight, and this interference...... was precisely his greatest variable for breaking the局.

dialogue.content: "The fake death predicament......" Chen Ji let out a low laugh, the smile carrying three parts mockery and three parts determination, "Since the world thinks Chen Xuan is dead, then let Chen Ji come alive." He stood up, his gaze cold and sharp as a blade, "The useless persona has been played for over six hundred chapters—it's time to get tired of it. This game, I will personally play."

text.content: The fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly trembled, and a blurry image appeared on its surface—depicting the scene at Chapter 700. In the image, Chen Ji stood alone atop mountains of corpses and seas of blood, surrounded by诡异的black lightning. His chest was pierced by a longsword, blood flowing profusely. However, in the next instant, the image twisted, and another possibility emerged: if he could seize the lock-key power in Chen Nian's hands...... that sword would backlash against its wielder.

choice.prompt: The Xuanwu Sect Sect Master is about to descend upon the imperial city, and sect war is imminent. Facing this great trend sweeping the world, Chen Ji needs to decide his first move—

choices.description: Reveal his true identity in the imperial city, declare before the Xuanwu Sect Sect Master that Chen Xuan is not dead, overpower with momentum, and seize the initiative with a thunderous entrance.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his identity may provoke a joint encirclement and suppression by the three major sects
choices.visible_reward: Shock the world, reputation soaring, shattering all forces' expectations
choices.risk_hint: High risk, high reward, may trigger chain reactions

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his aura suddenly soaring. He shed that weak and mediocre mask, his brows and eyes filled with pride that looked down upon the world. Above the imperial city, wind and云changed color, thunderclouds churning, as if even the Heavenly Dao was making way for his entrance.

choices.description: Continue hiding in the shadows, secretly contact the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's old subordinates and imperial court forces, lay a天罗地网before the Xuanwu Sect Sect Master arrives.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes large amounts of time and resources for the setup
choices.visible_reward: Firmly grasp the initiative of the battlefield in your hand, letting enemies step into the trap without knowing
choices.risk_hint: Medium risk, all efforts wasted if discovered

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flickered and merged into the imperial city's shadows. His fingertips traced secretive runes in the void, the unique communication method of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. In less than an hour, hidden agents throughout the imperial city responded one after another, and a net quietly spread open.

choices.description: Using Chen Nian as the breakthrough point, infiltrate the Holy Sect first to rescue his sister, fundamentally destabilizing the Tianji Record's prophetic stability.
choices.visible_cost: Deep in the heart of the Demonic Path, extremely dangerous
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key', completely rewrite the trajectory of fate, creating cracks in the Heavenly Eye's布局
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, but the reward after success is beyond estimation

text.content: Chen Ji gazed toward the direction of the Holy Sect, his eyes flickering with rare tenderness. "A'Nian, big brother is coming to save you." He murmured softly, then his form turned into a流光and rushed straight toward the heart of the Demonic Path. There, someone he must protect awaited.

choices.memory_label: 陈念是陈机最大的软肋

text.content: However, the image on the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly shifted. A towering figure like a mountain was pressing down from the horizon—the Xuanwu Sect Sect Master, surrounded by ancient Black Tortoise shadows, his威压如渊似海. Behind him, one hundred thousand Xuanwu disciples were stationed outside the imperial city, their iron armor like a forest, cold light eclipsing the sun. Sect war...... had truly arrived.

dialogue.content: "Chen Xuan!" A roar shook the clouds, Han Lie strode through the air, his eyes red as blood, "You waste, daring to deceive the world for six hundred chapters! Han Lie has fought you three times, lost three times—today, I will personally cut off your head to wash away the shame!" The halberd in his hand pointed at Chen Ji, his battle intent soaring.

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, looking down at that face twisted with rage, the corner of his mouth slightly raised. "Han Lie ah Han Lie, besides shouting to fight and kill, what else can you do?" His voice was not loud, yet it clearly entered each person's ears, "Three defeats, three growths, three times trampled underfoot—the stronger you become, the stronger I become. In this chess game, you are merely a piece in my hand."

dialogue.content: Han Lie's halberd thrust out violently, and the Black Tortoise shadow roared along with it. This strike alone was enough to destroy the world. Yet Chen Ji merely raised his hand gently, his fingertip tapping lightly—the strike that could have torn apart the heavens actually shattered inch by inch in mid-air. Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, his face full of disbelief.

text.content: "Useless?" Chen Ji walked slowly toward Han Lie, each step seemingly stepping on the latter's heart, "Han Lie, do you know why I never kill you?" He bent down, approaching that terrified face, and whispered, "Because the stronger you become, the more you become a blade to sharpen me. I need a whetstone sharp enough—and you, happen to qualify."

Han Lie collapsed to the ground, his past pride and confidence gone without a trace at this moment. The Xuanwu Sect disciples looked at each other in dismay, their morale plummeting. The Xuanwu Sect Sect Master's face was dark as water, and just as he was about to strike, a rift suddenly cracked open in the sky—within that rift, a gigantic eye slowly opened, its pupil reflecting the fate of the entire world.

dialogue.content: The voice came from all directions, grand and cold, like the eternal Heavenly Dao murmuring: "Chen Xuan...... you have finally reached this point. The chess game of Chapter 700, I have waited ten thousand years." In the Heavenly Eye's pupil was reflected Chen Ji's entire life—from a废物disciple to a chess player who laid out schemes for the world. "You think you are the chess player? No, you have always been a piece."

text.content: Chen Ji stared directly at that eye transcending all things, his gaze utterly fearless. He suddenly burst into laughter, the sound echoing between heaven and earth, "Heavenly Eye? Ten thousand years of布局?" He spread open his hands, and all four pages of the Tianji Record bloomed with golden light, "Unfortunately, you overlooked one thing—Chen Ji never plays by the rules." He turned to gaze in a certain direction, where a figure bound by chains was desperately struggling.

dialogue.content: "Brother!" Chen Nian's voice pierced through layers of bindings, entering Chen Ji's Mental Sea directly. That one cry contained power that actually made the Heavenly Eye's pupil slightly contract. "The Heavenly Eye laid out its strategy for ten thousand years, yet it couldn't calculate human hearts." Chen Ji murmured softly, "A'Nian, you are my variable—and also the biggest loophole in this game of chess."

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's pupil contracted sharply, its voice carrying a tremor for the first time: "You dare......" Chen Ji interrupted it, saying loudly: "Chapter 700, I await you— THIS GAME, I WILL PLAY MYSELF!" His voice was like thunder shaking the three realms, the four pages of the Tianji Record trembled in unison, countless threads of cause and effect and fate appearing around him. He finally saw his true opponent—not Han Lie, not Xuanwu Sect, not Holy Sect, but the will that transcends the Heavenly Dao itself.

Wind and云changed color, thunderclouds churned like an angry sea above the imperial city. The Heavenly Eye slowly closed, yet the rift did not disappear but instead expanded even more, as if tearing open a portal for the approaching ultimate showdown. The Xuanwu Sect Sect Master's face was ashen, Han Lie had been overwhelmed by Chen Ji's aura, and Chen Ji's figure amid the intertwining golden and thunder light was like a神祇looking down upon the world.

Chen Ji withdrew his aura and turned to gaze into the depths of the imperial city. There, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's old subordinates were assembling; there, the imperial court's hidden agents had been on standby for a long time; there, a beautiful figure he had been waiting for—Su Qingyao had long sensed his true identity, standing quietly atop the city tower at this moment, gazing at him with complex eyes. The storm had arrived, and the chess player...... had finally bared its fangs.

Chen Ji gazed into the void, where there was the Heavenly Eye's final gaze, and also his destined final game. A faint smile curved his lips, that笑意carrying three parts wildness, three parts determination, four parts mockery of fate. Chapter 700, he would keep the appointment. And this time, he would personally rewrite the already destined outcome on the chessboard.
